stories.title: An unmanageable club? Carrick the latest to suffer in Manchester United’s faded grandeur
summary: Only Matt Busby and Alex Ferguson have truly succeeded in the Old Trafford hot seat with each casting uneasy shadowsShould any football club fit the Great Man theory of history it is Manchester United.
In the past 100 years, only Matt Busby and Alex Ferguson have knocked the club into shape.

Otherwise, United has been a managerial dustbin, Michael Carrick the latest likely lobbed on the pile.Busby and Ferguson built the club around themselves, possessing the charisma to convince others that theirs was the path to follow.
